text.en: What safety practices do you follow when working with electrical installations?
text.fil: Anong mga safety practice ang sinusunod mo kapag nagtatrabaho sa mga electrical installation?

criteria.name: Correct safety practices
criteria.description: Names specific, correct practices such as lockout-tagout, PPE and verifying de-energization.
key_points: verifies absence of voltage with a tester

5: Before working I switch off the breaker, apply lockout-tagout, and verify zero voltage with a tested voltage detector. I wear insulated gloves and safety shoes, and I never work alone on live panels.
3: I turn off the power and wear gloves.

criteria.correction: List concrete steps: switch off, lock and tag, test for voltage, and wear the right protective equipment.

criteria.name: Standards awareness
criteria.description: Refers to the Philippine Electrical Code or workplace procedures.
key_points: mentions the Philippine Electrical Code or a standard

5: I follow the Philippine Electrical Code for wire sizing and grounding, and I always follow the site's work permit procedure and my supervisor's instructions.
3: I follow the rules we learned in school.

criteria.correction: Mention the Philippine Electrical Code or the workplace procedure you follow.

text.en: A three-phase motor trips its overload relay repeatedly. How would you troubleshoot it?
text.fil: Paulit-ulit na nagti-trip ang overload relay ng isang three-phase motor. Paano mo ito ita-troubleshoot?

criteria.name: Diagnostic steps
criteria.description: Checks supply, load, motor and protection settings in a logical order.
key_points: checks for phase loss or voltage imbalance
measures motor current against the nameplate

5: I would measure the voltage on all three phases for loss or imbalance, then clamp the current and compare it to the nameplate. I would check the overload setting, and inspect the load and bearings for mechanical binding. I would also megger the windings.
3: I would check the wiring and the motor for problems.
1: I would replace the overload relay.

criteria.correction: Work through the causes in order: supply voltage, motor current, overload setting, then the mechanical load.

criteria.name: Correct instruments
key_points: names a clamp meter or multimeter

5: I would use a clamp meter for current, a multimeter for voltage, and an insulation resistance tester for the windings.

criteria.correction: Name the instruments you would use, such as a clamp meter and an insulation tester.
